ITEM.PTXT: The shift position indicator is located in the center of the combination meter, and displays the current shift position by illuminating the LCD.
When the shift position is moved to "R", the area around the "R" display blinks.
When the shift position is moved to "M", the M (manual shift) mode indicator light "M" illuminates and the current gear is displayed.
The engine control computer receives the shift position signal from the neutral start switch and transmits it to the meter computer via CAN communication.
Upon receiving this signal, the meter computer displays the currently selected shift position on the display LCD.

When the shift position "M" signal is input, the engine control computer also receives the shift switch operation (UP/DOWN) signal and transmits it to the meter computer as a CAN communication signal.
Upon receiving this signal, the meter computer illuminates the M (manual shift) mode indicator light "M" and displays the currently selected gear on the display LCD.
